title: Clinical Embryology Courses in Punjab & HP | EmbryoGenesis
description: Clinical embryology courses with EmbryoGenesis and ITHS: B.Sc., M.Sc., Ph.D. and PG Diploma at Rayat Bahra University, Mohali, and Bahra University, Himachal.

schema.name: Courses at EmbryoGenesis
schema.description: B.Sc., M.Sc., Ph.D. and PG Diploma programmes in Clinical Embryology and ART & Clinical Embryology offered by EmbryoGenesis with ITHS, Bahra University and Rayat Bahra University.

schema.name: Clinical Embryology and ART & Clinical Embryology programmes

item.name: BSc in Clinical Embryology
item.description: Explore the rapidly growing field of Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) with our BSc & MSc in Clinical Embryology program at Bahra University. Eligibility: 12th with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology. Duration: 4 Years.

item.name: MSc in Clinical Embryology
item.description: Explore the rapidly growing field of Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) with our BSc & MSc in Clinical Embryology program at Bahra University. Duration: 2 Years (4 Semesters).

item.name: B.Sc. in ART & Clinical Embryology
item.description: EmbryoGenesis, in collaboration with Rayat Bahra University and the Institute of Translational Health Science (ITHS), offers comprehensive academic programs in ART & Clinical Embryology. Eligibility: 12th with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Math. Duration: 4 Years.

item.name: M.Sc. in ART & Clinical Embryology
item.description: EmbryoGenesis, in collaboration with Rayat Bahra University and the Institute of Translational Health Science (ITHS), offers comprehensive academic programs in ART & Clinical Embryology. Eligibility: B.Sc./B.Tech in Life Sciences, MBBS, BDS etc. Duration: 2 Years.

item.name: Ph.D. in ART & Clinical Embryology
item.description: EmbryoGenesis, in collaboration with Rayat Bahra University and the Institute of Translational Health Science (ITHS), offers comprehensive academic programs in ART & Clinical Embryology. Eligibility: Post Graduation in relevant field Duration: 3-4 Years.

item.name: PG Diploma in ART & Clinical Embryology
item.description: EmbryoGenesis, in collaboration with Rayat Bahra University and the Institute of Translational Health Science (ITHS), offers comprehensive academic programs in ART & Clinical Embryology. Eligibility: B.Sc./M.Sc. in Life Sciences, MBBS etc. Duration: 1 Years.
